items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) questionable after limited/no full Friday practice; McVay says he lacked power/explosion and will test pregame. If out, Stafford target hierarchy: Higbee primary then Mumpfield/Parkinson/Atwell etc.
items.why: Calf felt during Thursday practice majority; no single play identified; pregame test planned.
items.implication: Major volume funnel if OUT; monitor pregame closely for start/sit and DFS.
items.opportunity: TE/WR hierarchy expansion (Higbee lead) and remaining Rams pass-catchers if inactive.

items.text: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) ruled OUT Week 7. SF DvP inflates opposing RB production 4.4% (7th-most); recent RB receptions high. Sweet full-workload setup for Bijan Robinson.
items.implication: Bijan to workhorse snaps/carries/RZ without committee theft; RB1 ceiling unlocked.
items.opportunity: Full Bijan workload vs soft SF RB DvP (catches + run).

items.text: 49ers WR corps decimated (Evans/Deebo OUT). George Kittle will go nuts in scheme with entire WR group hurt; ignore National TE Day narrative.
items.why: Shanahan/Schefter confirm Evans (Achilles) and Deebo OUT vs ATL.
items.implication: Massive Kittle target/RZ share spike; CMC also elevated but Kittle primary pass funnel.
items.opportunity: Kittle WR-injury funnel + scheme; start with confidence.

items.text: Cole Kmet to IR with season-ending knee injury. Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet absence likely reduces 2/3-TE sets and gives Burden more juice/opportunity.
items.why: Serious knee suffered Thursday night; coach confirms IR/season-ending.
items.implication: Burden route/target share rise; Loveland already surging post-Caleb return (30% targets, 19+ PPR).
items.opportunity: Burden YPRR efficiency + expanded routes; CHI TE/WR funnel.

items.text: Saquon Barkley in line to return Week 7 vs Cowboys (MNF). Efficient in prior full games; Dallas strong RB matchup. Start him if active.
items.why: Back at practice; efficiency data + matchup.
items.implication: Immediate RB1/2 restart; no ramp-up assumed by Berry.
items.opportunity: Full workload expected vs soft Dallas run D.

items.text: If Breece Hall plays vs Miami, start him immediately despite Stephania Bell caution. Strong matchup.
items.why: Practice return; Berry overrides caution for volume/matchup.
items.implication: Must-start if cleared; MIA soft vs RBs.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share expected if active.

items.text: Lamar Jackson officially questionable (high ankle sprain); practiced Friday, said 'headed in the right direction.' Could be GTD vs Bengals.
items.why: Missed prior two games; positive practice progression and player comments.
items.implication: If active, major upgrade for Ravens skill (Flowers/Andrews/Henry); monitor final ruling.
items.opportunity: Ravens pass/run game full strength potential.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK and surging since Caleb Williams return: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec and 60+ yards both games. Love.
items.why: Usage spike with Williams healthy; Kmet IR adds more.
items.opportunity: High target share + efficiency in Bears offense.

items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren (groin) and CB Sauce Gardner (calf) ruled OUT vs Vikings.
items.implication: Colts TE vacuum; check backups/Allen targets.
items.opportunity: Possible streamer TE or WR target bump in IND.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% of snaps over last three weeks. Concerning role/usage trend.
items.implication: Hard to trust as starter/flex; monitor for any role expansion.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (high-ankle) ruled OUT another week by coach LaFleur.
items.implication: ARI RB committee or other backs elevated; avoid Love.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed facility access (meetings/lifting/treatment, non-football). Backups MarShawn Lloyd (49th EPA/rush) and Kaleb Johnson (53rd) poor; OL mess contributes. Long-term outlook discussed on ROS show.
items.why: Facility non-football activities permitted; backup EPA data.
items.implication: Jacobs return timeline positive but short-term backups untrustworthy; hold Jacobs.
items.opportunity: Avoid GB backup RBs; Jacobs value intact longer-term.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs short-term workload post-layoff.

items.text: Loves: AJ Brown (@CHI volume), DeVonta Smith (elite volume vs DAL), Tucker Kraft & Matthew Golden (@DET soft secondary/deep), Jaylen Warren (@NO), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB), Bucky Irving (@CAR). Matchup + workload driven.
items.why: Bears yardage spots; Lions pass-catcher buffet (deep % + TE TDs); RB workloads vs soft run Ds.
items.implication: Prioritize these in start/sit and DFS.

items.text: Hates: Rome Odunze (vs NE shadow), Josh Downs (low share/low-scoring), Travis Kelce (@SEA tough), Josh Jacobs (workload post-layoff @DET), Cam Skattebo (brutal spot).
items.why: Nasty matchups, role/target issues, or return uncertainty.
items.conflict: Levitan notes Jacobs facility progress + poor backups.
